rationale: The stock gapped up 23% on strong earnings but is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($26.10) and the 9-EMA ($25.83), sitting at only 34% of today's range with a clear downward momentum in the last five 1-minute candles (accelerating volume on the sell side, last candle 33K shares down to $25.27). The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.31%, VIXY +7.17%), which adds headwind to any long thesis, while the stock has already retraced significantly from its $27.45 high, making a short entry risky given the fundamental catalyst still in play. With price below VWAP and EMA but no clear support level established, the risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction at this moment.
